intro: Popular, well-maintained BG3 mods. Many need Norbyte's Script Extender. Each mod's page lists its full requirements; install those too.

mods.name: Script Extender (BG3SE)
mods.summary: Adds Lua scripting to the game; needed by many gameplay and utility mods.
mods.note: BG3 Mod Manager can install and update it for you.

mods.name: BG3 Mod Manager
mods.summary: Sets load order, exports it to the game and installs the Script Extender.

mods.name: Community Library
mods.summary: Shared code and assets that many content mods depend on.

mods.name: Mod Configuration Menu (MCM)
mods.summary: One in-game settings menu for every mod that supports it.

mods.name: Compatibility Framework
mods.summary: Lets class, race and subclass mods coexist without overwriting each other.

mods.name: ImpUI (ImprovedUI)
mods.summary: UI library that lets mods add classes, races and options to menus.

mods.name: Party Limit Begone
mods.summary: Raise the party size above four.

mods.name: Tutorial Chest Summoning
mods.summary: Summon a chest of handy starter items from your spellbook.

mods.name: 5e Spells
mods.summary: Adds tabletop 5th Edition spells that Larian left out.

mods.name: UnlockLevelCurve (Level 13-20)
mods.summary: Raises the level cap to 20 with matching XP curve.

mods.name: WASD Character Movement
mods.summary: Move your character directly with the keyboard.

mods.name: Tav's Hair Salon
mods.summary: Large set of extra hairstyles for character creation.
